property_summary: Only the admin (the deployer) can successfully call setOwner; the correct contract always only allows the original admin to change owner, whereas the mutant allows the current owner to call setOwner (so a non-admin owner can change owner), violating the rule for some fuzzed owner addresses.
change_summary: Change the onlyAdmin modifier to require msg.sender equals owner (not admin), so calls passing onlyAdmin will be allowed only for owner, altering who can call setOwner.
